newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Danone launches 7.5 bln esc Navigator bond.
newsitem.headline: Danone launches 7.5 bln esc Navigator bond.

text.p: Danone Finance is launching a 7.5 billion escudo, seven-year bond indexed to six-month Lisbor rate plus 35 basis points for the first three years and a fixed 7.30 percent for the remainder, lead manager and bookrunner Deutsche Bank de Investimento said.
The issue carries a call option at par exercisable with five-days warnings on April 28, 2000.
BORROWER Danone Finance SA AMOUNT 7.5 billion escudos
INTEREST Six-month Lisbor plus 35 basis points for first three years then fixed 7.30 percent
PAYMENT FREQUENCY Six-monthly for first three years, annual thereafter
REIMBURSEMENT par LISTING Lux GOVT LAW UK
